04 / DIGITAL EXPERIENCE

FORM / DIGITAL

An editorial approach to a fashion website. A digital space that gives imagery and typography equal presence.

UI DESIGN · CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT2026SELF-INITIATED CONCEPT

The idea.

The concept translates a fashion identity into a responsive digital experience. Strong type, flexible image proportions and deliberate motion support a simple way to explore the collection. The visual system is designed to move comfortably from a desktop campaign to a small mobile screen. These illustrative interface mockups explore desktop and mobile layouts, with a consistent visual language across the homepage, collection and editorial views.
